{{Quote|I have my orders, Master Skywalker. Please help me carry them out with minimum fuss.|An unidentified Bothan CSF captain|<ref name="Rebirth" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] '''individual''' with pale [[Color/Legends|gold]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] for the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="Rebirth" /> In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the Bothan held the [[police rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and was monitoring [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] traffic. They ordered [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] to return to the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as they had instructions from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government to not let them leave. They refused to return and the captain authorized a chase by four [[Coruscant Security Force interceptor|CSF interceptors]]. However, [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] interfered, causing the CSF interceptors to back off and thus allowing the Skywalkers to escape.<ref name="Rebirth" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bothan appeared in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'', a novel written by [[Greg Keyes]] and published in [[2001]].<ref name="Rebirth" />
